items.title: Blockchain.com To Go Public At $6 Billion Valuation
items.summary: Blockchain.com says it plans to go public by year’s end at a $6 billion U.S. valuation.

items.title: Nasdaq Launches Agentic AI Environment for Calypso Capital Markets Platform
items.summary: Nasdaq (NASDAQ:NDAQ) has launched an agentic artificial intelligence operating environment within its Nasdaq Calypso capital markets and treasury platform, allowing financial institutions to deploy and connect AI agents across trade lifecycle workflows. The environment, announced on September 29, 2026, is built on the Model Context Protocol, or MCP, an emerging standard for connecting AI agents with software systems.

items.title: NYSE, Blockchain Team Up For Round-The-Clock Trading
items.summary: NYSE is partnering with a crypto-transaction firm to develop around-the-clock stock trading, the latest in a series of moves among financial firms that seek to expand and globalize stock trading.
